usage: Refers to the bassoon, a low double-reed orchestral woodwind; use it as a normal countable noun in music contexts.
Very common in formal or school music settings, especially when talking about orchestras, bands, or instrument classes.
Can be used with measure words like 一支 / 呢支 when you mean one bassoon, especially in spoken Cantonese.
Learners should note that this is a direct instrument name, so it is not used as a general word for other wind instruments.
